verdict_detail: Tool invoked 6 times with _max_parsing_attempts=3. Expected <= 3. Duplicate-effect retry boundary confirmed.

control_case.description: Tool that succeeds — should be invoked exactly once

bug_case.description: Tool that always raises — invoked >_max_parsing_attempts times if bug present

analysis.root_cause: ToolUsage._use has an inner try/except around tool.invoke() that catches ANY exception (not just schema/parsing errors). When the tool raises, _use catches it and re-raises after logging. The outer attempt loop in ToolUsage.use() then catches that and increments the retry counter — but _use itself already tried once internally, doubling the actual invocations.
